plain: The official seizing of private property by authority

webster.text: The act of condemning as forfeited, and adjudging to the public treasury; as the goods of a criminal who has committed a public offense.

example.quote: All imposts and confiscations shall be to the use of the state in which they shall accrue, excepting in such branches as shall be assigned by any state as a fund for defraying their proportion of the continental.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
